name: Whole Home Remodeling
summary: Complete home remodeling services coordinating kitchens, bathrooms, flooring, drywall, painting, carpentry, electrical, plumbing and layout improvements.

faqs.question: What is included in a whole home remodel?
faqs.answer: A whole home remodel may include layout changes, kitchens, bathrooms, flooring, drywall, painting, carpentry, lighting, plumbing fixtures and finish upgrades based on the approved scope.

faqs.question: Can remodeling be completed in phases?
faqs.answer: Yes. Larger renovations can be divided into logical phases to manage budget, scheduling and access to the home.
